day_shape: 69 items: two tankers hit off Khasab near Strait of Hormuz with UKMTO confirmation, Iran claims F-16 damage and 19th MQ-1 downed over Qeshm, CENTCOM marks day 130 of blockade, State Dept sanctions four IRGC-linked oil insiders, IDF strike kills four Hamas operatives in Bureij.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incidents
threads.summary: UKMTO reported two tankers leaving the Strait of Hormuz were struck by unidentified projectiles off Oman's Khasab on Saturday less than an hour apart, with one on fire. Iran's Army Navy said a 'violating tanker' struck a naval mine east of the Strait after entering a prohibited area with navigation systems off.

threads.label: US blockade and oil-sanctions enforcement
threads.summary: CENTCOM marked 130 consecutive days of what it called a blockade preventing IRGC oil exports, while the State Department sanctioned four Iranian regime insiders including a former IRGC intelligence officer and the son of Mahan Air's head. US Treasury officials met Singapore and Malaysia regulators to warn on sanctions compliance, and Bessent said Iran's rulers were 'wounded cornered animals'.

threads.label: Iranian claims of US aircraft hits
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB claimed Iranian air defences damaged a US F-16 on Friday evening in the south, and that a 19th MQ-1 drone was destroyed over Qeshm Island. Defa Press described 'a heavy bill' overnight against US F-16, F/A-18, F-35, P-8 and MQ assets following Trump's remarks.

threads.label: IRGC missile posturing and Israel planning
threads.summary: IRGC commander-in-chief visited a missile city with aerospace commander Mousavi touting 'terrifying surprises' and the unveiling of a new dual-missile launcher, per Tasnim and Defa Press. Jerusalem Post reported Israel's defence establishment preparing for possible renewed confrontation with Iran and seeking a broader regional coalition, while IDF Spokesman Defrin said public guidelines remain unchanged.

threads.label: Hardliner tanker-convoy threats
threads.summary: Iran International reported IRGC-linked media, lawmakers and Friday prayer leaders are pushing a tanker convoy to challenge the US blockade, with threats to strike Persian Gulf oil infrastructure if vessels are fired on. IRIB and Defa Press amplified claims about Strait of Hormuz closure raising US inflation to 3.8% and pressuring major US tech firms.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure: energy, internet, dissent
threads.summary: Officials warned that at current consumption gas and electricity restrictions loom for Azar and Dey, after wartime damage left 11 provinces facing shortages according to Iran International. A parliamentary bill would tie online accounts to real identities, the State Department accused Tehran of using executions to silence dissent, and a licensing proposal targeting journalists is being revived.

threads.label: Gaza, Yemen and Iran-linked overseas activity
threads.summary: The IDF said an airstrike in Bureij, central Gaza, killed four Hamas operatives including Nukhba members planning attacks, while the Saudi-led coalition struck Hodeidah port and Houthis warned airlines off Saudi airspace. Iran International reported Iran-linked hackers posed as a US think-tank expert to target Australian broadcaster Erin Molan, and two men charged over an alleged RAF Fairford plot indicated not-guilty pleas with trial set for November 2027.
